result.topic_en: Hilbert completes an argument about a second-order linear differential equation, showing that a degree-(2n-1) function G(z) has no zeros other than z=0, that the functions N and Z are uniquely determined, and he begins determining the Riemann-type critical points from the expansions of f(z).
